name: Instruments In The Church
overview: Scripture reveals that instruments play a significant role in worship within the church, as seen in Psalms 150 where the trumpet, psaltery, and harp are used to praise God in His sanctuary. Isaiah 38 emphasizes singing with stringed instruments as an expression of gratitude to the Lord. Ephesians 5 encourages believers to sing spiritual songs and make melody in their hearts, while James 5 highlights singing psalms in times of joy. Together, these passages affirm that musical instruments and singing are integral to expressing heartfelt worship and praise to God.
